4.collectionName: NEON Invertebrate Voucher Collection at Arizona State University
4.datasetname: Pinned invertebrate reference collection specimens for NEON invertebrate bycatch samples for the development of site-level invertebrate species checklists.

11.datasetname: Carabid vouchers collected in a pitfall trap deployed for approximately 2 weeks as per the NEON carabid sampling protocol. Archived in 95% ethanol and pooled across traps from the same plot and sampling dates.

13.datasetname: Bulk unsorted invertebrate bycatch collected in a pitfall trap deployed for approximately 2 weeks as per the NEON carabid sampling protocol Carabids and vertebrates have been removed. Remaining samples are archived in 95% ethanol and pooled across traps from the same plot and sampling dates.

63.datasetname: Genomic extract from the leg of a pinned carabid voucher collected in a pitfall trap deployed for approximately 2 weeks as per the NEON carabid sampling protocol. Used for barcoding and archived at -80 degrees C.
